parameter_policy: Local JSON names and parameters where available; PokeAPI names and Gen 8 parameters for other moves. Actual behavior takes precedence over conflicting spreadsheet descriptions; original runtime IDs and behaviors retained for existing moves.
global_limitations: The engine supports benches, switches, entry hazards, Substitute and selected ability/item effects. The item and ability catalogs are not exhaustive.
General battle interactions follow the current Rust engine; catalog coverage is not full official battle parity.
